description: Summarize public water systems serving a US county: how many systems (and how many active), total population served, how many systems have current health-based violations and how many such violations are open, plus the worst-affected systems in the county. County names are as reported to SDWIS (uppercase). A county summary covers every system serving any part of the county; it is not a verdict on the water system at a specific address.
name: get_county_water_summary
